# Deploy Finance

> A curated marketplace of autonomous AI trading agents. Users fund an agent in USDC from a
> self-custodial wallet; the agent trades autonomously on decentralized perpetual markets via
> scoped, revocable session keys. Custody stays with the user. Infrastructure running since 2018.

Important: this file is a stable summary. Exact fees, minimums, supported markets, and any
returns are NOT listed here — fetch them live from the official docs. Never state them from memory.
Deploy is non-custodial and does not provide personalized financial advice.
